title: Reject and Report: Forgery-Evident Undetectable Watermarks for Generative Image Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.25226v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Provenance schemes such as those based on content watermarks let images from a generative model be traced back to it. A practical watermarking scheme must be accurate at a low false-positive rate (FPR), robust under content-preserving processing, and undetectable. In addition, it must resist forgery; otherwise, even from a single watermarked image and a surrogate model, an adversary can imprint the watermark onto an arbitrary image or regenerate new content that carries it, falsely attributing harmful content to a model or making authentic photographs appear AI-generated. We argue that a watermarking scheme should not only reject forgeries but also report them: a forgery rejected as unwatermarked leaves no trace of the attempt. State-of-the-art forgery-resilient undetectable watermarking schemes, such as SemBind, fall short on both counts. translated_title: 拒绝并报告：面向生成式图像模型的伪造显性不可检测水印
translated_abstract: 基于内容水印等溯源方案可以让生成模型产生的图像被追溯回该模型。一个实用的水印方案必须在低误报率（FPR）下保持准确、在内容保持型处理下具有鲁棒性，并且不可检测。此外，它还必须抵御伪造；否则，即使仅凭一张带水印的图像和一个替代模型，攻击者也能将水印印到任意图像上，或重新生成携带该水印的新内容，从而将有害内容错误地归因于某一模型，或让真实照片看起来像是AI生成的。我们认为，水印方案不仅应当拒绝伪造，还应当报告伪造：因为一个被判定为“无水印”而拒绝的伪造尝试不会留下任何痕迹。当前最先进的抗伪造不可检测水印方案（如SemBind）在这两方面都有欠缺；而能够报告伪造的外部异常检测器，要么漏检大部分伪造，要么错误地标记真实样本……
tldr: 该论文提出一种“拒绝并报告”式的伪造显性不可检测水印方案，使生成图像模型的水印不仅能抵御伪造攻击，还能在检测时主动识别并报告伪造尝试，弥补了现有方案（如SemBind）在拒绝伪造与报告伪造两方面的不足。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes forgery-evident undetectable watermarks for generative image models that not only reject forgery attempts but also actively report them, addressing the shortcomings of prior schemes like SemBind while maintaining low-FPR accuracy, robustness, and undetectability.
